name: @zakkster/lite-o1
author: Zahary Shinikchiev <shinikchiev@yahoo.com>
description: Zero-dependency, zero-GC family of O(1) data structures that witnesses its constant: SparseSet (O(1) add/has/delete/clear/iterate), RingDeque (O(1) fixed-capacity numeric double-ended queue), UnionFind (near-O(1) amortized disjoint-set), MonoDeque (O(1)-amortized monotonic deque for sliding-window min/max), MinStack (worst-case-O(1) stack with running min/max), RandomSet (O(1) set with worst-case-O(1) uniform sampling + swap-remove), FreqO1 (worst-case-O(1) LFU frequency structure), BucketQueue (amortized-O(1) monotone integer priority queue / Dial), TimerWheel (worst-case-O(1) bounded simple timing wheel), HierarchicalTimerWheel (amortized-O(1) cascading multi-level timing wheel), RingLog (worst-case-O(1) lossy overwrite-oldest ring log), CuckooMap (bounded-probe worst-case-O(1) lookup exact integer-key map via bucketized cuckoo hashing), SparseTable (worst-case-O(1)-query static range-minimum/range-maximum table / StaticRMQ), BitSet (fixed-capacity multi-word dense bitset with worst-case-O(1) per-bit test/set/clear/toggle and worst-case-O(1) firstSet/nextSet via a 3-level popcount summary), AliasTable (worst-case-O(1) Vose weighted sampling from a static build-once table), CoarseTimerWheel (worst-case-O(1) non-cascading near-unbounded approximate-fire timing wheel, Linux-4.8 coarse-bucket model), WindowFold (worst-case-O(1) general FIFO sliding-window aggregator over SUM/MIN/MAX/PRODUCT, DABA-Lite), RankSelect (worst-case-O(1) static succinct rank/select bitvector index over a frozen bit pattern, cs-poppy 512-bit basic blocks), and EliasFano (worst-case-O(1)-access static succinct codec for a monotone integer sequence in ~2 + log2(U/n) bits/element, built on the rank/select layer) with a throughput-invariance witness harness. Tree-shakeable named exports.

scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:types && npm run torture && npm run witness && npm run test:perf
